summary:
Three people, including a pilot, were killed in attacks on Riyadh's international airport on Thursday, Saudi authorities said on Friday. Yemen's Houthis claimed the attacks as they stepped up missile strikes on the kingdom and tried to shut its airspace. In Ukraine, Kyiv accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians after two buses were blown up in the frontline city of Kramatorsk on Thursday, killing at least 30 people and wounding 18. President Volodymyr Zelensky vowed the attack 'will not go unanswered.'

Navi Pillay, a former judge in South Africa and on international courts, was named winner of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for efforts to promote international law. The Nobel committee chair said she was instrumental in ensuring war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide are prosecuted. Canadian poet, translator and essayist Anne Carson, 76, won the Nobel Prize in Literature, hailed for her 'bold and inventive' work.

The United States on Thursday charged ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, with conspiracy to commit torture, adding to drug trafficking and firearms charges. Prosecutors allege detainees, including US citizens, suffered waterboarding and rape. The couple have been jailed in New York since early January.

headlines.title: Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport kill three, Saudi Arabia says
headlines.summary: Saudi authorities said on Friday that three people, including a pilot, were killed in Thursday's attacks on Riyadh's international airport. Yemen's Houthis claimed the attacks as they stepped up missile strikes on the kingdom and tried to shut its airspace.

headlines.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30 in Kramatorsk
headlines.summary: Ukraine accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians after two buses were blown up in the frontline city of Kramatorsk on Thursday, killing at least 30 and wounding 18. One account describes a glide bomb, another a missile; Zelensky vowed the attack 'will not go unanswered.'

headlines.title: Navi Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for promoting international law
headlines.summary: Navi Pillay, a former South African judge who led a UN panel on Gaza, was named 2026 Nobel Peace Prize winner. The Nobel committee chair said she was instrumental in ensuring war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide are prosecuted.

headlines.title: Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
headlines.summary: Canadian poet, translator and essayist Anne Carson, 76, won the Nobel Prize in Literature, hailed for her 'bold and inventive' work. Her writing often crosses boundaries between poetry, fiction and scholarship.

headlines.title: US charges Maduro and wife with conspiracy to commit torture
headlines.summary: Prosecutors charged ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, with conspiracy to commit torture, adding to drug trafficking and firearms charges. They allege detainees, including US citizens, suffered waterboarding and rape; the couple have been jailed in New York since early January.

headlines.title: Trump says US will not strike Iran before midterm elections
headlines.summary: Trump ruled out strikes on Iran before the 3 November midterm elections, after media reports suggested he was weighing them. Oil fell on Friday after surging the previous day, as traders weighed the pledge against shipping risks in the Persian Gulf.

headlines.title: Student protests close 141 French high schools for fifth day
headlines.summary: Student protests over overcrowded classrooms, teacher shortages and broken-down buildings continued for a fifth day, with 141 high schools closed on Friday, according to the education ministry. The education minister pledged on Thursday to deploy 3,000 extra substitute teachers.

headlines.title: South Africa withdraws asylum directive after anti-migrant violence
headlines.summary: Home Affairs withdrew a directive on the intake of asylum applications after anti-immigration protests turned violent in Durban and Soweto on Thursday. Ten cars were set alight in Orlando West, Soweto, following violence between community members and foreign shop owners.
